summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release stating that subsidiary Vale Base Metals completed a transaction establishing Exiro Nickel Company as new owner and operator of the Thompson Mine Complex in Manitoba, Canada — the US-equivalent disclosure of a asset sale/divestiture plus strategic-review conclusion. Exiro Minerals Corp., Orion Resource Partners LP and Canada Growth Fund Inc. collectively hold 81.1% of Exiro Nickel; Vale Canada Limited retains 18.9%. No price, premium or consideration was disclosed. All customary regulatory and government authorizations were received. VBM also signed a multi-year nickel concentrate offtake from the Thompson mill. Watch residual stake value, offtake economics and any earn-out or environmental liabilities retained.
